title: dsa2
summary: A generic, config-driven Data Science / ML framework (dsa2) that unifies model, data, and preprocessing definitions under a single dictionary/JSON interface. Its model_sampler and prepro_sampler modules import SDV's tabular TVAE and CTGAN synthesizers and its timeseries PAR model to generate synthetic data as one of the framework's optional preprocessing/sampling steps.
